in_sanskrit.name: Inira
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Dwelling in the Divine
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Inira एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Inira is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a combination of the words 'in' meaning within and 'rama' meaning divine. The name Inira signifies dwelling in the divine or residing in the realm of the gods.
